implementation_notes: JUnit 5 with `@ParameterizedTest`, Testcontainers for real dependencies, `@WebMvcTest` for slice tests, and AssertJ for fluent assertions. Keep integration tests in a Maven/Gradle source set that runs separately so the unit phase stays fast.
idiom_name: JUnit 5 parameterised tests + Testcontainers in a separate phase
pitfalls: @MockBean-heavy slice tests that never touch a real mapper
Integration tests in the same phase as unit tests, so the fast feedback loop is lost
